rows.grounds: means or instrument required for action
the doer or agent performing action
the act or doing performed by the agent
the locus or object upon which action is directed

items.question: Is an instrument necessary for an agent's action upon an object?
premises: An agent performs action directed toward an object.
Action upon an object is not observed without an instrument.
Observation supports the dependence of action on an instrument.
items.inference: Therefore an instrument is necessary for an agent's action upon an object.
items.plain_english: Without an instrument, an agent's action upon an object is not observed.
